skill_friction: AskCoworker's I template produced one Create PermissionSet row plus seven Update rows on the same PermissionSet; the skill says one row per deployable component but gives no explicit rule to merge Create+Update of the same component, so the merge was a judgment call recorded in Section 8.

Whether a CustomTab is in scope for a request that names only a permission set ('nothing else') is a fork the skill does not address; decided by the Rule 5 default (responsibility left undelivered without it) rather than asking.

org-verification.md says FieldDefinition is a cross-check for FLS-hidden fields, but in this org FieldDefinition also hid the 7 FLS-less fields; only Tooling CustomField returned them. The note could say FieldDefinition may also be filtered.

AskCoworker labelled facts '[Verified: prior session]' even though they were supplied in the message; the handling table covers echoed facts but these labels are misleading when counting verified vs reported claims.

The Tooling CustomTab object has no SobjectName column; the reference lists TabDefinition implicitly but not how to find a custom-object tab reliably (the DeveloperName LIKE query returned no rows even for the existing Storefront__c tab).
